title: Hidden mass in early galaxies revealed by bottom-heavy initial mass functions
efc_relevance: From nine massive quiescent galaxies at z ~ 0.7 (JWST IMFERNO NIRSpec + VLT LEGA-C), the oldest (z_form > 5) has the most bottom-heavy IMF; the authors state its possible high-z progenitors 'may' have had similar IMFs, raising their masses by a factor ~4 +/- 1. This is a CONDITIONAL mass correction for possible progenitors, not a z>10 mass measurement. If it holds it weakens the premise that the JWST early-galaxy sample requires new cosmological growth physics - the premise on which EFC's early-structure (S_flow) addressing rests.
ledger_action: Recorded in the Atlas external-evidence register (FRAG-CHENG-IMF) as a conditional premise-defeater linked to early_structure_JWST. No Validation Ledger row: it is an IMF inference at z ~ 0.7 that bears on the anomaly budget, not a test of an EFC prediction.
